name: Jahaziel
overview: Jahaziel was a male Benjamite who came to David's aid at Ziklag, as recorded in 1 Chronicles 12:4. His presence among those who joined David at Ziklag highlights his role in supporting David during a critical time. This association situates Jahaziel within the tribe of Benjamin and within the narrative of David's rise.
namesAndTitles: The name Jahaziel means 'G-d [El] will see,' reflecting a theophoric element that acknowledges God's awareness and providence. This proper name, mentioned in 1 Chronicles 12:4, carries a meaning that points to divine oversight.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Jahaziel as a descendant of the tribe of Benjamin, as stated in 1 Chronicles 12:4. Beyond this tribal affiliation, no further family relationships are documented for him.
scriptureSignificance: Jahaziel's significance lies in his support of David during the time at Ziklag, marking him as one of the Benjamites who aligned with David. His inclusion among David's followers illustrates the gathering of diverse tribal support essential for David’s eventual kingship. This demonstrates the providential hand of God in uniting His chosen leader with loyal supporters from various tribes.
